anchor.quote: The thermal zone you inhabit directly shapes your chaos tolerance

claims.rationale: The claim asserts a direct climate-to-chaos-tolerance mechanism without defining chaos tolerance, exposure duration, acclimatization, population, measurement, or causal evidence.

legacy.quote: "The thermal zone you inhabit directly shapes your chaos tolerance"

anchor.quote: Higher ambient temperatures correlate with expanded creative processing bandwidth

claims.rationale: Thermal-cognition research reports nonlinear, task- and comfort-dependent effects rather than a general warmer-means-more-creative relationship; no source supports the asserted heritable creative-bandwidth correlation.

legacy.quote: "Higher ambient temperatures correlate with expanded creative processing bandwidth"
legacy.note: Presented as settled and "measurable, heritable"; the correlation and its heritability are contested hypotheses, not established findings

anchor.quote: I was not depressed. I was thermally misaligned.

claims.rationale: The narrator reports a situated multi-year change in felt cognitive range after moving climates. It passes only as a first-person interpretation, not as a clinical exclusion of depression or a universal thermal mechanism.

legacy.quote: "I was not depressed. I was thermally misaligned."
legacy.note: First-person, replicable-in-principle embodied observation; the post's experiential backbone — clean

anchor.quote: Temperature zones function as processing environments.

legacy.quote: "Temperature zones function as processing environments."

anchor.quote: The equatorial band generates high-context processing cultures.

legacy.quote: "The equatorial band generates high-context processing cultures."

anchor.quote: Languages in these regions pack more meaning into fewer words.

anchor.quote: Sanskrit compresses entire philosophical systems into single syllables.

legacy.quote: "Sanskrit compresses entire philosophical systems into single syllables."

anchor.quote: Tamil Sangam poetry embeds mathematical structures in verse form.

legacy.quote: "Tamil Sangam poetry embeds mathematical structures in verse form."
